boundary: Every previously exported message object and bundle is retained. Current canonical conversation views are merged, including archive-only sessions absent from native discovery. Fixed per-session byte cutoffs exclude later work. Hidden reasoning, internal instructions, credentials, unreviewed tool bodies and unsupported attachments are not exported. This is a visible-record snapshot, not a complete provider trace.
correction_reason: The first pass encountered compressed .zst files at native paths. Its binary-line parser gaps were transport errors, not missing chat messages. This pass decompresses those fixed snapshots as streams and replaces their current gap inventory; all earlier messages, bundles and reports remain retained.
